decisions.summary: make canon searches every canon file for every term at once; canon-read-hooks.sh refuses direct canon reads and a make canon within three calls unless it names every earlier term; registered in .claude/settings.json at /diagram/scripts/canon-read-hooks.sh.
decisions.why: The GM made mechanical enforcement the condition, 'especially on recommendation number one', for the round that follows. Measured 2026-09-27: /diagram/scripts/canon-read-hooks.sh and _hm_canon.py do not exist (ls), the registration points there, and feature 250 cannot land while tasks are open, so the guard is inert in every session T61 runs - and T61's queue is running now (runner pid started 00:05). Replayed through the clone's copy, the fabric write session 3cac8497's canon greps are refused, so the mechanism is right and only its reach is missing. Two further narrowings of the recommendation: (a) the REPEAT rule passes any chain of growing calls (measured: 'a', 'a|b', then 'a|b|c' passes, rc 0), so fifteen sequential searches are still allowed provided each re-names the earlier terms; 'in ONE command' is narrowed to 'each command a superset'; (b) the recommendation's first half, 'give the write brief the canon's own index ... name budgets.md and l7r.md', is not in the write brief at all (no 'canon' in brief.py), so the session learns the command only by being refused first.
